text:
emma: FYI Helio Systems (HLX-091) put account on hold. INV-2026-422 due 2026-03-18 unpaid: $67,890. AP claims a $15,000 spike from a misrouted test and wants that portion credited. They offered to wire $30k today and update card for remainder. We need decision: accept wire + provisional credit, require signed plan, or escalate.
jorge: Sales flags them as mid-market growth customer. Would prefer to avoid churn but get something on ledger. Any history of disputes?
nora: CX logs: no prior disputes. Last payment 2026-02-01. billing-bot: Charge attempt 2026-03-19 failed: card declined. Auto-flag triggered for abnormal usage on 2026-03-17.
trevor: Finance: can accept wire. Need remittance details and beneficiary name. We should require at least 40% upfront or PO with AP contact. Wire fees billed back.
cfo: CFO here  For accounts this size, require exec signoff for terms >60 days. Ok to accept conditional plan with >=40% up front and collateral (PO or signed plan).
emma: Legal wants a short clause: provisional credits subject to telemetry reconciliation, and payments do not waive collection rights.
jorge: Sales proposes: accept $30k wire today, provisionally apply $5k credit pending telemetry, pause seat increases and beta features until first tranche clears, and offer net-45 for remainder if they sign payment plan.
trevor: Prefer a 3-pay split: 40% now ($27,156), 30% in 30d ($20,367), 30% in 60d ($20,367). If they insist on wire $30k, that covers the first tranche. Approve if we get remittance + signed plan.
nora: CX to monitor and step into thread if they reply. Also request VAT billing address for invoice correction.
emma: Draft message to customer (will paste before sending): 
"Hi Helio  we received your inquiry about INV-2026-422. To prevent service interruption while we investigate, please wire $30,000 to the account below (customer pays SWIFT fees) and reply with remittance. We will provisionally apply a $5,000 credit pending telemetry reconciliation (final determination within 10 business days). The remaining balance may be split over 45 days upon receipt of a signed payment plan and PO. Seat increases and beta features will be paused until the first tranche clears. If we do not receive remittance or signed plan within 7 business days, we will escalate to collections.
Please provide VAT billing details if applicable.
Bank details: (sent privately)."
Is this OK to send?
jorge: Approve from Sales. Add line offering to waive one late fee as gesture of goodwill.
cfo: Approve the structure. Waive a single late fee only. Monitor cash flow impact.
emma: Sending now to ap@heliosys.co 2026-03-20 11:03 UTC  Subject: URGENT: INV-2026-422 Payment & telemetry reconciliation
billing-bot: Note: reattempt scheduled 2026-03-25.
nora: CX will draft the telemetry reconciliation request and coordinate with ops.
emma: Pasted sent copy above. Will follow up if no remittance in 3 business days.
jorge: Thanks team. Keep me posted, I9ll coordinate with account owner for renewal timing. :handshake:
